params.prompt: Create ONE original logo concept for Berth, a self-hosted Android emulator fleet for AI agents and humans. The concept is a safe assigned dock for a borrowed device. Produce a professional isolated brand logo, with one symbol above one wordmark except for the typographic option. The only text must be Berth (or berth when specified). Center on a pure white square canvas with generous margins. Keep the full lockup within the central 70 percent. Flat vector artwork, crisp paths, recognizable small silhouette. No mockups, photographs, shadows, textures, explanatory labels, taglines, watermarks, multiple alternatives, or famous-brand imitation. Swiss modernist identity. Design an exceptionally simple geometric capital B monogram, with a rectangular docking slot carved from its negative space. A single device block fits into that slot. Strong proportions, precise grid, flat navy #132B45 with teal #19A6A0 accent. Bespoke clean sans-serif Berth wordmark.
